why: The reorg tombstone is deleted from the reply on its way out, so the wallet reads as if the spend were still in the chain. The live set is byte-identical either way -- a tombstoned record is not live -- so only sequence equality over the whole emitted history can contradict it. WHAT THIS PROVES AND WHAT IT DOES NOT: it proves btc_reorg can still see a missing tombstone. It mutates nothing inside the adapter: the wrapper spawns the real binary and rewrites its stdout. A wrong mapping baked identically into map.rs and into this case's hand-written expect block survives it, and survives every other mutant here.
